hestia_auth_user_customer_scope.name: hestia_auth_user_customer_scope
hestia_auth_user_customer_scope.value: (workspace_id IS NULL) OR ((phone_number IS NOT NULL) AND (email IS NULL))

hestia_auth_user_identifier.name: hestia_auth_user_identifier
hestia_auth_user_identifier.value: (email IS NOT NULL) OR (phone_number IS NOT NULL)

design_tasks_conversation_check.name: design_tasks_conversation_check
design_tasks_conversation_check.value: ((protocol = 'deterministic-v1'::text) AND (conversation IS NULL)) OR ((protocol = 'conversation-v1'::text) AND (conversation IS NOT NULL))

lead_follow_events_kind_check.name: lead_follow_events_kind_check
lead_follow_events_kind_check.value: (kind = 'status' AND status IS NOT NULL AND note IS NULL) OR (kind = 'note' AND status IS NULL AND note IS NOT NULL AND length(note) BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

lead_follow_events_status_check.name: lead_follow_events_status_check
lead_follow_events_status_check.value: status IS NULL OR status = ANY (ARRAY['new'::text, 'contacted'::text, 'active'::text, 'won'::text, 'parked'::text])
